home.title: Find care with a little more confidence.
home.subtitle: MedMatch connects real patient histories with the care providers and therapies that may help next.
home.cardTitle: The right questions can change the whole search.
home.h1Text: Find care providers by specialty, city, therapy, and the experiences that matter to you.
home.h2Text: Read thoughtful recommendations from people who have walked a similar path.
home.h3Text: Write an experience with the privacy settings and display name that feel right.
